titleInfo.title: Non-random reflections on health services research
titleInfo.subTitle: on the 25th anniversary of Archie Cochrane's Effectiveness and efficiency

tableOfContents.#text: Introductory reminiscences -- Archie Cochrane's legacy: an American perspective / Kerr L. White -- reminiscence of Archie Cochrane / Richard Doll -- Archie Cochrane: an appreciation / Dick Cohen -- Archie and the Nuffield Provincial Hospitals Trust / Gordon McLachlan -- "What have Communism and Catholicism against randomised controlled trials?" / Andre Rougemont and Etienne Guberan -- Some reactions to Effectiveness and Efficiency / Hugh F. Thomas -- Pt. 1. Epidemiology -- 1. Response rates in south Wales 1950-96: changing requirements for mass participation in human research / Julian Tudor Hart and George Davey Smith -- 2. So what's so special about randomisation? / Jos Kleijnen, Peter Gotzsche and Regina A. Kunz -- 5. Cochrane and the benefits of aspirin / Peter Elwood -- 6. Social work: beyond control? / Geraldine Macdonald -- Pt. 3. Efficiency -- 7. Health economics: has it fulfilled its potential? / Alan Maynard and Trevor A. Sheldon -- Pt. 4. Equity -- 8. Beyond effectiveness and efficiency ... lies equality! / Alan Williams -- 9. Equitable distribution of the risks and benefits associated with medical innovations / William Silverman -- Pt. 5. Evolution -- 10. Large-scale randomised evidence: trials and overviews / Rory Collins, Richard Peto and Richard Gray -- 11. Cochrane Collaboration / Iain Chalmers, David Sackett and Chris Silagy -- 12. Improving the reporting of randomised controlled trials / David Moher and Jesse Berlin -- 13. Exploring lay perspectives on questions of effectiveness / Sandy Oliver -- Cochrane's obituary.

note.#text: edited by Alan Maynard and Iain Chalmers.
